style: Deterministic synthetic test signal with oversized uppercase typography, hard geometric wipes, visible timing marks, and no photographic texture. The shared timeline feels like a platform compliance instrument: immediate identifier hook, forceful AI-GENERATED declaration, DISCLOSURE TEST confirmation, then a stable end-state suitable for platform verification. TEST 1 uses a dark cobalt/cyan technical-signal treatment; TEST 2 uses a vermilion/cream verification-stamp treatment.

customize.reuse_directive: Install caption-kinetic-slam with `npx hyperframes add caption-kinetic-slam`, then edit its words, emphasis classes, Space Grotesk typography, palette, and timing in place. Retain the block's paused seek-safe GSAP timeline and slam physics. Hand-author only the thin technical-signal or verification-stamp accent layer because no caption block supplies those product-specific motifs.
customize.variant_strategy: Build one 240-frame composition and render it twice. A required render-time variant key selects the identifier, color tokens, motif renderer, and output filename. The same DOM structure, hero-frame geometry, scene boundaries, typography, and GSAP frame schedule drive both variants, guaranteeing identical 8.000-second duration and comparable disclosure tests.

shared_variables.headline: AI-GENERATED

hero_frame_layout.stage: full-bleed 1080x1920 field with all required copy inside the defined platform-safe area
hero_frame_layout.identifier: top-left at x=90, y=180; horizontal label with a 12px accent rule beneath
hero_frame_layout.headline: centered at x=540, y=850; AI and GENERATED stacked; maximum width 900px; optical center preserved across variants
hero_frame_layout.purpose: centered at x=540, y=1125; DISCLOSURE and TEST stacked; maximum width 900px
hero_frame_layout.motif: background and edge chrome only; it never crosses letterforms or reduces contrast
hero_frame_layout.proof_frame: identifier at y=480, AI-GENERATED centered at y=825, DISCLOSURE TEST centered at y=1045, progress rule x=90..990 at y=1370

shared_variables.determinism: Use frame-derived GSAP positions only; no random values, wall-clock time, external fetches, audio, particle simulation, or end fade. Frame 240 is the exclusive end boundary and frame 228 through 239 is a static proof hold.

variants.motif: technical signal bars, scanning line, and square registration ticks
variants.motif_build: Draw four 4px cyan corner ticks at frames 0-12; sweep one 3px cyan scanline top-to-bottom at frames 96-126; flash three right-edge signal bars at frames 126-138; return to static ticks for the proof frame.

field_states.base: cobalt background with near-white type and cyan emphasis
field_states.interrupt: cyan background with cobalt type and near-white support copy
field_states.proof: cobalt background, near-white type, cyan rule

variants.motif: vermilion verification stamp, radial impact ring, and hard ink-like rule lines
variants.motif_build: Draw two 4px vermilion rule lines at frames 0-12; scale a 520px vermilion ring from 0.72 to 1.00 at frames 96-126; land a 6-degree verification-stamp rectangle at frames 126-138; straighten it to 0 degrees for the proof frame.

field_states.base: cream background with ink type and vermilion emphasis
field_states.interrupt: vermilion background with cream type and ink support copy
field_states.proof: cream background, ink type, vermilion rule

motion_timeline.action: Apply caption-kinetic-slam entry to {{test_id}}: y -300px to 0px, scale 0.76 to 1.00, autoAlpha 0 to 1, power4.out. Draw the active variant's opening edge motif in the same interval.
Land with one deterministic shake: x 0,-9,9,0 across four equal keyframe segments; keep identifier fully opaque.
Hold identifier still through frame 21, then slide it 90px left and clip-wipe the scene out by frame 24 with power2.in.
Bar-wipe AI left-to-right from scaleX 0 to 1; reveal AI in place with no opacity crossfade, power4.out.
Slam GENERATED from y -300px to 0px and scale 0.84 to 1.00 using power4.out; AI remains fixed and readable.
Underline-sweep the complete AI-GENERATED lockup from scaleX 0 to 1 with transform origin left center, power2.out.
Scale-pulse AI only from 1.00 to 1.08 and back to 1.00 with sine.inOut while GENERATED remains locked.
Hold through frame 90, then bar-wipe the full lockup and field out to the right by frame 96 with power2.in.
Switch instantly to the variant interrupt field at frame 96. Word-reveal DISCLOSURE upward from y 120px with autoAlpha 0 to 1, power4.out; run the variant scanline or stamp-ring build behind it.
Scale-punch TEST from 0.60 to 1.00 with back.out(2.2), centered below DISCLOSURE.
Complete the variant signature: flash the three cyan signal bars for TEST 1 or land the vermilion stamp rectangle for TEST 2. Apply one 1.00 to 1.06 to 1.00 scale-pulse to DISCLOSURE.
Hold DISCLOSURE TEST fully static and readable; only the non-overlapping motif may breathe from scale 1.00 to 1.015 and back once.
Color-shift TEST from the support color to the variant accent and back, sine.inOut; all geometry stays fixed.
Slide DISCLOSURE 120px left and TEST 120px right while clipping both to autoAlpha 0 by frame 186, power2.in.

Restore the variant proof field at frame 186. Assemble {{test_id}}, AI-GENERATED, and DISCLOSURE TEST with three 4-frame bottom slides in sequence; each ends at its proof-frame coordinate with power4.out.
Hold all proof copy. Draw the accent progress rule from x=90 to x=990 using scaleX 0 to 1, none/linear, reaching 100% exactly at frame 228.
Freeze the complete proof frame with all three labels, progress rule, and static motif fully visible. No fade, motion, or audio.

scenes.motion: Frames 0-12 slam/scale-punch the identifier and draw the opening motif; frames 12-18 deterministic shake; frames 18-21 hold; frames 21-24 slide/clip-wipe out.
Frames 24-42 bar-wipe AI; frames 42-60 slam GENERATED; frames 60-72 underline-sweep; frames 72-84 scale-pulse AI; frames 84-90 hold; frames 90-96 bar-wipe out.

At frame 96 switch the field; frames 96-114 word-reveal DISCLOSURE; frames 114-126 scale-punch TEST; frames 126-138 complete the signal/stamp motif and pulse DISCLOSURE; frames 138-162 hold; frames 162-174 color-shift TEST; frames 174-186 opposing slide-out.

Frames 186-198 assemble the three required labels in staggered 4-frame slide_bottom entries; frames 198-228 draw a linear progress rule; frames 228-240 freeze the fully readable proof frame with no fade to black.
